concepts.title: 改訂KV：赤と青の対読
concepts.desc: 3枚目の正面構図を引き継ぎ、確定した二人に差し替え。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One finished high-quality 16:9 landscape LORE magical-library game key visual. ONE unified full-frame scene, never a collage or split panels.
INPUT REFERENCE ROLES:
Reference 1 is the FINAL APPROVED FEMALE CHARACTER. Identity and entire clothing design LOCKED.
Reference 2 is the FINAL APPROVED MALE CHARACTER. Identity and entire clothing design LOCKED.
Reference 3 is the APPROVED LIBRARY ATMOSPHERE/KEY VISUAL. Its two old male figures MUST be replaced, never retained or blended into new faces.
Exactly TWO young adult characters, one woman from ref1 and one man from ref2. NO extra people.

FEMALE INVARIANTS: pale golden-blonde hair flowing into silver tips; high voluminous long ponytail tied with a crimson bow; thin side braid, long face-framing strands; amber eyes; playful confident youthful face. Short asymmetric crimson shoulder capelet with pale trim, navy high-neck fitted bodice, long flat red bookmark ribbon and silver eye clasp; asymmetrical ivory PAGE-SHAPED skirt panels with red undersides, dark tights, ivory boots. Preserve her distinct red/black/ivory outfit. Do not turn her into a short-haired silver-haired boy or a white long-coat woman. Keep her ponytail visibly recognizable even in a medium-wide shot.
MALE INVARIANTS: spiky indigo blue hair with pale cyan front locks, short small rear braid, amber-gold eyes, youthful lightly confident face. Cropped COBALT jacket, tall near-black standing collar, asymmetric angular white shoulder panel, dark fitted shirt and navy cropped trousers, pale boots, short gloves; ONE long ivory split back cloth panel. His forearm tattoo/mark and asymmetric sleeve structure match ref2 when visible. Signature angular silver reading lantern with glowing cyan crystal. Preserve a BLUE cropped jacket, never replace it with the previous all-white robe or cape. Lantern can rest on table/hook nearby when hands hold cards.
Preserve their exact age, facial charm, hair colors, key clothing masses and silhouette. Draw them with the clean ink outlines and carefully separated cel-shadows of refs1/2, integrated into the more painterly atmospheric background of ref3. Do not regress to glossy airbrushed generic AI faces, ornate armor, gold filigree spam or excessive tiny silver diamonds.

WORLD: original Grand Archive of All Histories (万史大書庫), monumental white/silver stone library with navy shelf recesses and blue crystal lighting; one simple EYE/COMPASS circular archive seal, elegant gallery bridge and one small book circulation trolley. Physical bound chronicles, cards, reading lamps. White material surfaces are lit by deep-blue ambient light, rich navy negative space and controlled cyan accents. Red belongs primarily to heroine, bookmarks and one subtle cloth. The atmosphere is night-blue magical mystery, warm tiny reading lamps, polished white table, cool luminous books; NOT a flat daylight-white room. Match ref3's restrained majestic mood. Clearly a LIBRARY not church throne room. Large readable architecture, limited detail clusters, no dozens of orreries, no cosmic beasts, no cluttered holograms, no particle storm.
Branding: one small tasteful readable LORE wordmark in white at bottom center, closely matching the wordmark in ref3, about 17% canvas width. Set against a quiet dark-blue lower margin with no plaque and no obstruction of faces or hands. No other text, no UI/HUD, no card stats, no borders, no watermark. This is art, not a game interface.
MAIN REVISED KEY VISUAL: Treat reference 3 as the composition edit target. Keep its frontal eye-level wide camera, central round ivory table, great circular eye door at back center, blue-lit bookshelves and right-side bridge/trolley, and lower title placement almost unchanged. Replace the LEFT seated old man with the EXACT woman in reference1 and the RIGHT seated old man with the EXACT blue-haired young man in reference2. Both sit on opposite sides of the same round table, leaning slightly forward and looking toward their rival. Make the heroine's full flowing ponytail, red cape and page skirt visible; make the man's cobalt jacket and distinctive hair unmistakable. The heroine slides a red-backed card toward center with her near hand while holding a small card fan in the other. The man holds a fan of blue-backed cards and considers his response. His cyan lantern rests at the far-right table corner. An open bound chronicle between them emits a modest blue miniature memory of architecture. A few distinct cards lie in play on BOTH sides. Strong clear duel relationship, quiet strategic tension, equal visual weight. No weapons, no fighting bodies. Natural anatomy, two arms each, credible hand/card interactions. Retain the environment sophistication and restrained lighting of reference3 while using the new characters' clean 2D drawing style.
